bugs.name: pill-navigation-anchor-flow
bugs.summary: Desktop Project navigation link does not receive the active class after clicking and scrolling to #project.
bugs.evidence: Browser assertion failed twice (initial run and one allowed rerun): nav-project-link href=#project remained class "nav-link " instead of matching /active/. Failure screenshot: /root/.emergent/automation_output/20260827_092738_322/pill-navigation-anchor-flow-failure.png. Backend cross-check http://localhost:8001/api/ returned HTTP 200 {"message":"Hello World"}, so this is a frontend active-state issue, not an API failure.
